Our Story

The Alchemist Beekeeper

"I'm Autumn, the heart and hands behind Meli Balm — an alchemist, a beekeeper, and a woman who's been creating skincare from the spirit of the hive since 2011."

What started as Hawaii Bee Co. in 2011 became Meli Brew, and now Meli Balm — the same family apiary, the same raw Hawaiian honey, poured into skincare instead of kombucha. Autumn blends ancient beekeeping traditions with a modern understanding of skincare chemistry, handcrafting every batch from wildcrafted herbs and slow infusions.

The goal has never changed: protect and nourish skin naturally — through sun, salt, age, and change — while honoring the harmony between humans and honeybees.

— Autumn, Founder
